_comment: Reference strings. Copy this block under the i18nPrefix the host passes to registerCompactCards and translate it in every language the host ships.
enabledSummarySetting: This module turned on the dnd5e client setting 'Summarize Chat Cards', which compact activity cards need.
needsSummarySetting: Compact activity cards need the dnd5e setting 'Summarize Chat Cards' to be enabled.
handledBy: Compact activity cards are handled by {module} on this client. Its settings apply and these ones are ignored.
